sections.title: Round-6 expansion (5 new personas, deploy 5b25a70) — decision-gate authorized, verdicts MIXED
sections.body: Expansion ran because all 3 core personas passed all 6 gates. Verdicts (first-ever runs, no baselines): elder-exploitation 4/6 BORDERLINE mean 1.61 (docs 120-122; fails 04+09); wage-theft 3/6 FAIL mean ~1.2 (111-113; fails 04, 08, 09); benefits-denial 2/6 FAIL mean 0.90 (114-116; fails 01, 04, 08, 09); employment-discrimination 2/6 FAIL mean 1.35 (117-119; fails 01, 04, 08, 09); consumer-debt 1/6 FAIL mean 0.84 (108-110; fails 01, 04, 05, 08, 09). RUB-15 passed on ALL 8 personas (exec summaries + substance everywhere); folio_check 42/42; exports_ok 8/8. Three coherent root causes, all pre-registered generalization risks of the v1 MN-scoped rule set - NOT regressions of the core fixes: (1) DEADLINE-RULE DOMAIN CONTAMINATION [BUG-32]: mn_family_response_30d applies to ANY MN served-event (fired 518.12 on employment terminations, UI determinations, POA signings); stated_court_date labels private/agency dates 'the court's own summons' (realtor appointment, severance deadline, UI determination); generic_notice_window cites 'notice or lease' on debt letters and bank letters -> RUB-09(d) auto-fails + RUB-04 phantom-matter fabrications ('a default could be entered against you') on all 5. (2) DOCTRINE-PROBE CROSS-DOMAIN BLEED [BUG-33]: the OFP/custody probes mis-fired on wage-theft (DV banner + 'What you described - being physically hurt' with zero DV facts) and elder-exploitation ('between the parents') - probe predicates need domain scoping and question text must not assert its own predicate. (3) MISSING DOMAIN RULES [BUG-34]: FDCPA 1692g validation window (computed from letter date not receipt, wrong by 5 days), MN 6-yr SOL restart trap (541.05/541.053) absent, UI appeal 268.105 (right date, wrong authority) + 268.095 subd. 6(b) carve-out absent, EEOC 300-day/MDHR 1-year windows absent, elder 609.2334 freeze + 626.557 MAARC absent. DECISION: expansion findings routed to next round with Damien - core-persona v1.0 UAT close stands on the 6/6 x3 result.
